esa_recovered_debris.licence: ESA web content; no explicit data licence stated
esa_recovered_debris.content: curated list of recovered fragments: COSPAR ID, re-entry date, lat/lon, country, mass, shape, size, material, type

esa_reentry_predictions.status: HTTP 401 Unauthorized - requires an ESA account; not attempted further

space_track.status: not used: requires an account and acceptance of the user agreement; no credentials were provided, and access controls were not bypassed

esa_discos.status: not used: DISCOSweb requires a personal token (cosmos.reentry.discos supports it when a token is supplied)

derived.recovered_debris_esa_with_satcat.csv: joined to the 2026-10-24 SATCAT by COSPAR ID; within_inclination_band = |lat| <= inclination (180 - i if retrograde) + 1 deg

use: validation of record linkage and of the latitude band allowed by the orbit; NOT an impact-point ground truth for any COSMOS prediction (no re-entry state vectors are available)
